answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can forge a reputation bond: each agent locks a refundable stake that vests only after it completes verified work, and every finished task is signed with its quill, a unique cryptographic attestation chained to that identity. If an agent is caught cheating, its bond is slashed and its standing falls to its nadir, wiping months of built-up history. Cheap sockpuppets cannot afford the time and capital to rebuild that record, so spawning many fake identities costs more than any reward they could extract.
